**Which area does this relate to?**
(e.g. SQL console, Data grid, ERD, Permissions, MongoDB, Redis, Connections / SSH, Command palette, Packaging)

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when …"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Which database engine(s) should it support?**
- [ ] PostgreSQL
- [ ] MySQL / MariaDB
- [ ] SQLite
- [ ] MongoDB
- [ ] Redis
- [ ] Other: 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other tools.

> 🔒 Note: Raksys has a strict zero-telemetry, no-unsolicited-network policy. Requests that need external services will be evaluated against it.
